items.title: SpaceX, Tesla stocks sink as analyst warns Democrats' victory will create 'major hurdles' for AI build-out
items.summary: SpaceX, Tesla, and data center-related stocks declined on Wednesday after Democrats took control of the House and Senate, raising worries of a slowdown in AI data center build-outs.

items.title: SpaceX and Tesla 'need to find the path forward with Texas' on the back of midterm 'Blue Wave'
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) and SpaceX (SPCX) stock fell on Wednesday after Democrats took control of both houses of Congress in a "Blue Wave" that flipped Texas, home to both companies, with potential implications for CEO Elon Musk.

items.title: How Tesla and SpaceX stocks are reacting to Democrats winning Congress
items.summary: Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski joins The 8:30's Jake Conley and Pras Subramanian to discuss how Elon Musk's Tesla (TSLA) and SpaceX (SPCX) could be affected by Democratic midterm wins and if a merger could be fast-tracked ahead of the 2028 elections.

items.title: Apple Reportedly Tightens the Belt On Employee AI Budgets Amid Cost-Cutting Drive
items.summary: Apple Inc. is scaling back daily AI usage budgets for engineers and staff as part of a broader push to trim corporate spending, Bloomberg reported.

items.title: Rocket Lab Falls 4%, SpaceX Down 4% as Midterms Make Musk the “Biggest Loser”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysRocket Lab shares fell 4% after Democrats swept Tuesday’s midterms and the backlash against Elon Musk spread across space stocks. AST SpaceMobile and Planet Labs fell with SpaceX, though Rocket Lab is a SpaceX rival.
